author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jalen Duren drawing interest from Lakers
desc: Jalen Duren has a call scheduled with the Lakers on Tuesday to discuss potential sign-and-trade scenarios.
impact: Duren is also meeting with the Sacramento Kings on Tuesday, as the big man and the Pistons are reportedly far apart on a contract. The 22-year-old is coming off an All-NBA season in which he averaged 19.5 points and 10.5 rebounds per game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Domantas Sabonis linked to Pistons
desc: Domantas Sabonis has been linked to the Pistons in a potential sign-and-trade.
impact: Jalen Duren is slated to meet with the Kings on Tuesday. If he is indeed moved to Sacramento in a sign-and-trade, Sabonis is expected to be on the move back to Detroit.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Harrison Barnes intends to sign 1-year deal with Spurs
desc: Harrison Barnes intends to sign a 1-year, $8 million deal to return to the San Antonio Spurs for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Barnes will now be entering his third season with the Spurs after averaging 9.9 points last season. The veteran has been as reliable as they come during his time in San Antonio, missing just five games across the two seasons. He could transition to a bench role as the Spurs' young corps continues to grow.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kristaps Porzingis signs 2-year extension with Warriors
desc: Kristaps Porzingis has agreed to a 2-year, $40 million contract extension with the Golden State Warriors.
impact: Porzingis is now under contract with Golden State through the 2027-28 season with a player option in the second season. The veteran played in just 15 games after being traded to the Warriors last season, averaging 16.1 points and 5.3 rebounds with the team. His future role is still very much in question, as Golden State is currently at the center of many offseason rumors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kevin Huerter expected to sign three-year deal to return to Pistons
desc: Kevin Huerter intends to sign a three-year, $27 million deal to return to the Detroit Pistons.
impact: Huerter was acquired by Detroit last season, making three starts over 25 appearances. He'll continue to add shooting in a reserve role for them.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andre Jackson Jr. has team option declined by Bucks
desc: The Milwaukee Bucks are declining the team option on Andre Jackson Jr. for next season.
impact: Jackson will become an unrestricted free agent. He'll figure to seek a reserve role at guard with another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Taurean Prince opts into player option with Bucks
desc: Taurean Prince has chosen to opt in to his contract for the 2026-27 season and remain with the Bucks.
impact: Prince will remain in Milwaukee for another season. He'll figure to remain in a reserve role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julian Phillips has team option declined by Timberwolves
desc: The Timberwolves are declining the team option on Julian Phillips.
impact: Phillips is set to become an unrestricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Kuminga to draw interest from Kings
desc: The Kings are expected to show interest in Jonathan Kuminga.
impact: Kuminga had his team option declined by the Hawks, making him an unrestricted free agent. He should have several suitors in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ousmane Dieng to become unrestricted free agent
desc: Ousmane Dieng did not receive a qualifying offer from the Bucks.
impact: Dieng will become an unrestricted free agent. He'll figure to seek a depth role on another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Shulga has team option declined by Celtics
desc: The Celtics declined the team option of Max Shulga.
impact: Shulga will become an unrestricted free agent. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Amari Williams has team option declined by Celtics
desc: The Celtics declined the team option of Amari Williams.
impact: Williams will become an unrestricted free agent. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jusuf Nurkic intends to sign 2-year deal with Utah Jazz
desc: Jusuf Nurkic intends to sign a 2-year, $22 million deal to return to the Utah Jazz.
impact: Nurkic dealt with some injuries and played in just 41 games last season, but had a successful first year in Utah. The big man averaged 10.9 points, 10.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists per game. The Jazz's frontcourt depth could still see some shakeup this offseason, as Walker Kessler is the subject of many trade rumors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Walsh has team option picked up by Celtics
desc: The Celtics picked up the team option of Jordan Walsh.
impact: Walsh will remain off the fantasy radar.
